title: Deadline for Designated Smoking Corners to be Removed from Hawker Centres and Food Establishments
what_it_is: Deadline for Designated Smoking Corners to be Removed from Hawker Centres and Food Establishments

sections.label: Smoking corners in hawker centres
sections.summary: New hawker centres are smoke-free since 2015, NEA is progressively removing existing smoking corners, and there are no plans to enclose them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since 2015, all newly built and redeveloped hawker centres have been smoke-free.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: As for existing hawker centres, NEA has been engaging local stakeholders, such as the Hawkers' Associations and Town Councils, on the progressive removal of smoking corners when opportune, such as during repair and redecoration works.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA has also stopped accepting applications for smoking corners in food retail establishments since June 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Existing smoking corners in food retail establishments are allowed to remain until the current licence of the food retail establishment is terminated or cancelled.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: There are, currently, 21 hawker centres and about 560 food retail establishments with smoking corners, a decrease from the more than 950 smoking corners in June 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We expect the number of smoking corners to further reduce over time.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: There are, currently, no plans to require designated smoking corners to be enclosed or to be retrofitted with special air filters.
